documents.title: Academic Integrity (Undergraduate Catalog)
documents.summary: The undergraduate catalog academic-integrity policy defines misconduct and lists sanctions, the notification and appeal process, and the appeals board. AI appears in two definitions: AI as unauthorized material and generative AI used without explicit instructor permission.
documents.stance_why: The policy calls AI use academic dishonesty when done "without instructor’s permission" and "without explicit permission from the instructor"; AI is therefore banned unless permitted, which is restrict.
